what: Seller with 35 listings reports zero footfall on Gumroad for months until a viral Facebook post (10,000+ likes) drove traffic.
verbatim_snippet: "I had 35 listings and zero footfall. I was very suspicious. Yet another platform where I would put my time and energy and get nothing."
notes: Recovery method: Google search index snippet. Author is Dr. Seema Patel (PhD). Direct fetch blocked by robots.txt. Products: art and e-books. The viral Facebook event (10,000+ likes on a Buddhist monks peace walk art piece) appears in a later passage of the same article.
